title: ZMUIPNG USB C Docking Station Dual Monitor (2 HDMI 4K, DP 8K)
writeup: This ZMUIPNG USB-C dock is built to run two HDMI monitors, or three with its DisplayPort, from one laptop cable, with 100W power delivery passing through. Check your laptop first: the seller's own FAQ says Macs can only extend one screen and the others mirror, and it is not a DisplayLink dock. Owner reviews of the sister 14-in-1 model are mixed, with an M1 MacBook Pro 14 owner reporting it works and a Lenovo Yoga 7 owner reporting only two screens and one dropping out until replugged. Your laptop's USB-C port must support video output and charging.
